print_objects.name: The Pour

support_paint.scope: Outward/downward source R6 bed and aperture transition faces only. Horizontal functional ceilings remain supportable.

print_objects.native_schedule_scope: One model schedule per parent, including registered material/captive volumes. Leaf deposition witnesses require their supplied windows or material tool attribution.

support_paint.scope: Outward/downward source R6 bed and aperture transition faces only. Horizontal functional ceilings remain supportable.

material_source.scope: Saved PET-GF single-slot profile; no printer state inferred

physical_result: Unprinted compact reference; release, motion, finish, strength and lifetime remain unmeasured.
recipe_binding_scope: The generated-with digest binds the source bytes used for this editable project. Current preparer and native reader digests bind their recorded sources. The recipe-function digest binds construction and requested settings; project and native archive digests bind their saved bytes.

object_model_deposition.model_z_reading_scope: The model_nozzle_z_mm compatibility field and nominal_model_layer_z_mm read the native layer comment. Actual depositing nozzle Z endpoints are reported separately; spiral/scarf ramps are not planar slabs.
object_model_deposition.attribution_scope: Complete parent print object. Registered colours and captive bodies share this schedule; no individual leaf schedule is inferred.

complete_layer_bead_bounds.scope: Commanded width footprints for model, support, brim/skirt and prime-tower layer deposits. Machine Custom purge is excluded.

native.physical_scope: Requested settings and native model slabs/strand footprints; physical release, fit, seal, finish, strength and lifetime remain unmeasured.

material_frame_reading.scope: Native Tn is a filament selector. The emitted filament_map chooses its extruder; model XY equals G-code XY plus that extruder offset. This is source coordinate compensation, not observed physical registration.

ceiling_support_readings.name: Accessible rear supported crown flat
ceiling_support_readings.scope: Highest support nozzle Z in the isolated interior window to first roof underside from its actual parent Z step. Bridge flow height, sag, bead shape and physical release are separate.

source_profile_reading.scope: Native positive extrusion moves attributed to standalone source objects or shared assembly objects. Model nozzle-Z steps, strand-flow heights, wall-lane counts, commanded wall feeds and feature order are observed separately from requested 3MF options. Per-layer feature sequences can contain multiple islands; first-wall order does not qualify every island. Physical bead shape, infill overlap, surface and strength are unmeasured.

wall_probes.name: Left fixed bed round
wall_probes.footprint_overlap_scope: Two commanded line-width footprints on this transverse land; physical bead shape, contact area and bonding are unmeasured.

wall_probes.footprint_overlap_scope: Two commanded line-width footprints on this transverse land; physical bead shape, contact area and bonding are unmeasured.

specimens.local_wall_count_scope: Emitted wall-road crossings on supplied simple lands; corners, narrow stock and other islands can have different wall counts.
specimens.attribution_scope: Complete shared print-object schedule, reported once under the assembly ID; no individual leaf schedule is inferred from this object label.

attributed_body_deposition.model_layer_schedule_scope: Common print-assembly object schedule; leaf deposition is clipped to its unique supplied window.
attributed_body_deposition.deposition_height_scope: Strand heights include native bridge thickness; shared object Z steps describe the nominal layer schedule.
attributed_body_deposition.z_witness_scope: Explicit Z on depositing outer-wall moves witnesses native height ramps; it does not measure seam flatness.

attributed_body_deposition.model_layer_schedule_scope: Common print-assembly object schedule; leaf deposition is clipped to its unique supplied window.
attributed_body_deposition.deposition_height_scope: Strand heights include native bridge thickness; shared object Z steps describe the nominal layer schedule.
attributed_body_deposition.z_witness_scope: Explicit Z on depositing outer-wall moves witnesses native height ramps; it does not measure seam flatness.

captive_release_reading.scope: Native model-to-model contacts in the preserved print-assembly frame. Nominal bottom surfaces are first model nozzle Z minus the actual shared object model Z step; top surfaces are last model nozzle Z. Bridge strand-flow height is reported separately. Gap-window deposits exclude the exact contact planes. Lateral air subtracts half of each commanded line width from measured centerline separation. Travel is the supplied geometric stroke, not observed physical motion. These commanded slabs and strand-width footprints do not measure bead shape, sag, physical clearance, release force or reliable motion.

compact_readings.scope: Commanded native paths and width footprints in the supplied manufacturing frame. Physical sag, bead shape, release and motion remain unmeasured.

first_layer_model_footprint_isolation.scope: Connected unions of commanded first-layer model width footprints; physical bead shape and bonding remain unmeasured.

compact_readings.contour_start_scope: First/last positive Outer wall or Overhang wall points in contiguous native contour runs. Open runs are marked separately and their endpoint distance is not a seam gap. This witnesses commanded placement and path endpoints, not a physical ridge, groove or scarf outcome.

moving_support_contact_reading.cleanup_scope: Remove the automatic ceiling supports and their end-pocket roots before assessing the slide. The pockets are open upward beyond the initial lip ends, through the front aperture; rear crown access is retained. Actual removal and release remain unprinted physical results.
moving_support_contact_reading.measurement_scope: Model commands are classified by the frozen moving STL's nominal layer-midplane sections. Distances use commanded line-width footprints and model slabs, including neighboring slabs that share a Z plane. Strand sag, physical bead shape, removal force and reliable release are not measured.

compact_readings.saved_and_native_layers_scope: Both leaves share the single parent schedule. No individual leaf schedule or physical first-layer bonding is inferred.
